decisions.reason: As a flagship automation module tightly aligned with the firm's integrated precast-plant strategy, the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is very likely to remain in the portfolio.
The profile storage robot is somewhat more specialized, but it still supports plant automation and material flow efficiency within the firm's system-solution offering.
The automatic shuttering robot continues to complement broader automation packages and offers a useful modular option despite some overlap with more integrated robots.
The new combined magazining cleaning and plotting machine fits the firm's broad equipment range and, as a multi-model product line, is likely to be developed further rather than withdrawn quickly.
Production analysis software strengthens the firm's digital and lifecycle-support capabilities and is well suited to customers seeking higher efficiency and transparency in precast operations.
